sections.title: Annular Sector Recipe
sections.text: name is nonblank; innerRadius,outerRadius,height are positive length-expression strings with innerRadius < outerRadius. sweep magnitude is in (0,360 deg) (default 180 deg; use shape.ring for a full annulus); start defaults 0 deg. center is three sketch-local length expressions (z must evaluate within 1e-9 cm of zero); use plane/frame for 3D orientation. plane defaults XY and must be a native ConstructionPlane; frame is a datum.frame name or descriptor and creates a native plane aligned to it (mutually exclusive with a non-XY plane). operation:newBody(default)|join|cut|intersect; participants are nonempty native body refs resolved before creation for cut/intersect. The recipe builds two concentric arcs (inner/outer) and two radial cap lines, adds coincident cap-to-arc constraints, then driving radial dimensions for innerRadius and outerRadius. start/sweep expressions only initialize the arc geometry; the two radii remain native expressions. Component scope only; names name and name__section (plus name__plane for frame) are reserved across sketches/datums/features/bodies.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string,helpers:[SketchRef(,plane)],refs:{inner,outer,capStart,capEnd,origin},recipe:annular_segment,diameters:{inner,outer,start,sweep},atomic:false,isFullyConstrained:boolean,dependencies:string}. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and optional component/occurrence refs. Envelope {success,operation,document,result,created} records internal creations. Batch s.result.feature feeds pattern seeds; s.result.bodies.0 feeds body commands. Recipe is not atomic: solver/kernel failures can leave helpers; no rollback/save.

examples.label: Annular sector segment
examples.requires: Native component; Annulus and Annulus__section unused.
examples.output: result.recipe is annular_segment; result.refs.inner/outer identify the driving-radius arcs; result.diameters echoes the declared span.

verified: Radii as driving dimensions and sector closure

sections.title: Curved Strip Recipe
sections.text: name is nonblank; thickness,height are positive length-expression strings. centerline is either {radius,start?,sweep?,center?} or {start,through,end}; a three-point centerline is reduced locally to a circle center/radius, so the center is explicit or computed and never assumed at the origin. Top-level radius/start/sweep/center apply when centerline is omitted. Offset radii innerRadius=(radius)-(thickness)/2 and outerRadius=(radius)+(thickness)/2 become driving radial dimensions, retaining thickness as a native dependency. The strip is a closed profile of two arcs and two radial caps, extruded by height. plane defaults XY and must be native; frame is a datum.frame name or descriptor. operation:newBody(default)|join|cut|intersect; participants for cut/intersect are resolved before creation. Names name,name__section(,name__plane) are reserved.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {feature:Ref,bodies:Ref[],healthState:integer,message:string,helpers:[SketchRef(,plane)],refs:{inner,outer,capStart,capEnd,origin},recipe:arc_strip,centerline:{center,innerRadius,outerRadius,start,sweep},atomic:false,isFullyConstrained:boolean,dependencies:string}. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null. Envelope records internal creations. Off-origin blades require the explicit center or three-point centerline; there is no automatic re-anchoring to the global origin. Recipe is not atomic.

examples.label: Curved blade strip
examples.requires: Native component; Blade and Blade__section unused.
examples.output: result.recipe is arc_strip; result.centerline echoes inner/outer radii; thickness is retained in both radius expressions.

verified: Normal radial thickness as offset radii
Three-point centerline circle reduction and off-origin semantics

sections.title: Can Recipe
sections.text: name is nonblank; height,wallThickness are positive length-expression strings. Provide exactly one of diameter (a dimensioned rectangle revolved about the axis), profileData (structured revolve profile) or profile (existing native closed profile). axis defaults Y; opening is top(default)|bottom|none and shell removes the extreme cap face. radii is an array of positive fillet radius expressions applied to circular edges from the axis-extreme outward. plane defaults XY and must be native; frame is a datum.frame name or descriptor. operation applies to the blank revolve. The recipe composes model.revolve (blank), model.shell (opening) and model.fillet (radii), each a distinct native feature with its own name suffix (__blank,__shell,__fillet). Names name and name__section are reserved.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {blank:{feature,bodies,healthState,message},shell?:{...},fillets?:[{...}],helpers:[featureRef,...],recipe:can,atomic:false,dependencies:string}. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null. Envelope records internal creations. Batch c.result.blank.feature and c.result.shell.feature feed later pattern/body commands. Recipe is not atomic; wall thickness is uniform inside and a distinct bottom thickness is not modeled.

examples.label: Opened cylindrical can
examples.requires: Native component; Can and Can__section unused. Blank revolve/shell/fillet features must be kernel-feasible.
examples.output: result.recipe is can; result.shell and result.fillets describe the composed native features.

verified: Extreme cap-face and circular-edge discovery along X/Y/Z axes

sections.title: Impeller Recipe
sections.text: name is nonblank; hub {diameter,height,bore?} and blade {thickness,innerRadius?,outerRadius?,start?,sweep?,height?,centerline?} are descriptors with positive lengths. count is an integer >=2 or unitless parameter expression. The recipe creates a dimension-driven hub cylinder, then a seed blade arc-strip extruded with a join that targets the hub body implicitly (join carries no participants; the blade must reach the hub surface — supply innerRadius equal to the hub radius, or a radius/thickness whose inner edge is no greater than the hub radius — otherwise the join produces a detached blade), then a circular pattern of the blade feature count times about axis (default Z). Optional shroud/disk descriptors {profileData,thickness?} are revolved profiles joined to the hub. Optional participants/trim body refs limit the blade extrusion for cut/intersect. plane defaults XY and must be native; frame is a datum.frame name or descriptor. Geometry generator only: no aerodynamic or structural design. Names name plus __hub,__blade and their sections are reserved.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {hub:{...},blade:{...},pattern:{...},shroud?:{...},disk?:{...},helpers:[featureRef,...],recipe:impeller,atomic:false,dependencies:string}. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null. The blade depends on the hub body; the pattern depends on the blade feature; shroud/disk revolve join the hub. Envelope records internal creations. Recipe is not atomic.

examples.label: Six-blade impeller
examples.requires: Native component; Impeller and helper names unused. The blade innerRadius (10 mm) matches the hub radius (20 mm / 2) so the seed blade joins the hub.
examples.output: result.hub.feature, result.blade.feature and result.pattern.feature identify the dependency chain.

verified: Seed blade joined to hub implicitly (join carries no participants) and patterned

sections.title: Boss Pattern Recipe
sections.text: name is nonblank; boss {diameter,height} has positive lengths. hole/insert {diameter,depth} (when present) are positive; the hole is a native hole whose participants are the boss body, so it depends on the boss feature. layout.type is rectangular|circular|list: rectangular {direction,quantity,distance,directionTwo?,quantityTwo?,distanceTwo?,distanceType?}; circular {axis,quantity,angle?,phase?}; list {positions:[[x,y,z],...]} with at least two positions. The seed boss is a dimension-driven cylinder; the pattern depends on the boss feature (and hole feature when present). plane defaults XY and must be native; frame is a datum.frame name or descriptor. operation applies to the seed boss. Names name plus __boss(,__hole) and their sections are reserved.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {boss:{...},hole?:{...},pattern:{feature,positions?,recipe?},helpers:[featureRef,...],recipe:boss_pattern,atomic:false,dependencies:string}. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null. List layouts emit per-position seed copies rather than a native pattern feature. Envelope records internal creations. Recipe is not atomic.

examples.label: Circular boss-hole pattern
examples.requires: Native component; Bosses and helper names unused.
examples.output: result.boss.feature and result.hole.feature feed result.pattern as the patterned seed set.

verified: Seed feature(s) feed the native pattern
